text:
Ana (design): quick decision needed for the 'Create Cluster' form: dense/batch mode — do we show inline errors per field or a compact summary at the top that links to problems? also: required indicator — asterisk only or explicit 'Required' label?
Ravi (pm): for batch flows summary-first. users paste rows and inline noise is noisy. summary + anchors seems friendlier.
Tom (eng): perf note: hundreds of inline error nodes cause layout churn. we can lazy-mount inline messages on focus to balance both approaches.
Sofia (a11y): asterisk alone is risky for screen readers. recommend visible "Required" or use aria-required and a visually-hidden clarifier tied with aria-describedby. also add aria-live="polite" to the summary container.
Ana (design): copy tweak: current inline message "Missing name" -> propose "Please enter a cluster name." short and actionable.
Ravi (pm): +1. for destructive actions (delete cluster) we should use typed confirm for irreversible deletes, undo toast for recoverable ones. define threshold for bulk vs single.
Tom (eng): typed confirm requires focus management and clear SR instructions. undo toast requires backend retention. both feasible.
Sofia (a11y): if typed confirm is used, ensure the confirmation phrase is announced and the input receives focus. avoid focus traps that don't announce context.
Ana (design): proposal: default to summary-first (show count + links to first error), reveal inline messages when user focuses a field or after an attempted submit. show asterisk visually but include a visually-hidden "Required" tied to the input. tooltip on hover for sighted users.
Ravi (pm): sounds good. let's run a 6-person quick usability test (3 power, 3 novice) to validate discoverability.
Tom (eng): I'll prototype lazy-rendering and benchmark with a 250-row fixture. expect a branch by tomorrow.
Sofia (a11y): I'll review keyboard flows and NVDA/VoiceOver behaviour once the prototype is up. checklist: skip-to-errors, aria-live polite, anchors move focus appropriately.
Ana (design): quick poll: react :one: for inline-eager, :two: for summary-first.
RedwoodBot: New reactions added :eyes:
Ravi (pm): :two:
Tom (eng): :one:
Sofia (a11y): :two:
Ana (design): summary-first leads. I'll upload mocks for summary-first + inline-on-focus and an inline-eager variant for testing. tagging @Tom and @Sofia for implementation and a11y review. thanks!
